high_level_description: The image is a promotional poster for the movie "Weapons," which is set to be released on August 8th. The poster features a dark, ominous sky with a child running away from a group of silhouetted figures that appear to be children as well. The setting suggests a suburban neighborhood with houses on either side of a street. The text on the poster provides a chilling narrative: "Last night at 2:17 AM every child from Mrs. Gandy's class woke up, got out of bed, went downstairs, opened the front door, walked into the dark...and they never came back."
